This site brings together my CV, publications, teaching, and open research topics for students in one place.

It is built with [Quarto](https://quarto.org) and published on GitHub Pages. The same source files generate both these web pages and a PDF version of my [CV](../../cv/solaemanachmad_cv.pdf), so everything stays in sync.

In this section I plan to share short notes on research, teaching, and tools I find useful.
